en.name: Mastermind
en.ability: If the Demon dies by execution (ending the game), play for 1 more day. If a player is then executed, their team loses.
en.flavor: The tentacles of that monster are nailed to the doors of the church. Mothers and children are dancing in the street. Excellent. Everything is proceeding exactly as I have planned.
